lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular local maxima are arranged in multiple quasi-parallel horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The most prominent centroids are located in the central lateral region, forming a non-linear grid of pixel clusters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible checkerboard grid of anchor nodes across the visible mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and a distinct shadow region immediately below.
